notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.content:
- added graphics options (low, medium, high)
- added option to disable physics
- optimization for low end PCs

If you previously had low fps try tp change graphics quality to low - you should see huge difference now in performance. Other players even on high quality will see decent increase of fps.

notes.title: Update v 2
notes.content:
- migrated to unreal engine 4.27.1
- fixed that level select displayed early than game completion
- minor improvements

tags.bug: - fixed that level select displayed early than game completion

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
- After delivering the letters you will be granted an opportunity to choose any level.
- Also after that you will be able to open and close choose level menu on button L (keyboard)/X (on gamepad)
- Fixed render glitches of PostBox
- Restart hint now will appear after 30 second of idle and dissapear right when you start move

If you're already completed the game before this update you also will be able to choose levels even if you restarted the game
